# Victory Capital and Apollo Announce Strategic Private Markets Collaboration


November 16, 2026 7:49am EST[Download as PDF](https://ir.apollo.com/_assets/_09943e834dc6ef763d76eb17adceafcb/apollo/news/2026-11-16_Victory_Capital_and_Apollo_Announce_Strategic_661.pdf)


*Combining Apollo’s global private markets platform with Victory Capital’s leading model portfolio and distribution capabilities to expand access for financial advisors and individual investors*


SAN ANTONIO & NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Victory Capital (NASDAQ: VCTR) and Apollo (NYSE: APO) today announced a strategic collaboration that brings Apollo’s private markets investments alongside Victory Capital’s public markets capabilities to expand private markets access to a broader range of investors through new, diversified investment solutions. The collaboration will pair Apollo’s global private markets investment expertise with Victory Capital’s proven model portfolio platform and distribution capabilities across wealth and retirement channels.


The collaboration draws on Apollo’s leading private markets capabilities across private credit, hybrid, real assets, and secondaries. WestEnd Advisors, a Victory Capital Investment Franchise known for its dynamic macro-driven strategies and as a trusted model portfolio provider to financial advisors, will lead this extension of model portfolio solutions into private markets, giving financial advisors and individual investors access to strategies and structures that have historically been reserved for institutions.


“Private markets offer the ability to build more diversified portfolios, providing investors with exposure to companies, assets, and differentiated sources of return that investors may have difficulty accessing through public markets alone,” said Jason Leibowitz, Managing Partner at WestEnd Advisors. “In Apollo, we selected a private markets partner we have known and respected for years. They bring the scale, origination capabilities, and breadth to provide differentiated investment opportunities across private market asset classes and the capital structure, and have led the way in bringing daily pricing and transparency to private markets. Together, we are excited to deliver innovative investment options that complement the solutions our clients already trust us to provide.”


“As public and private markets continue to converge, we believe the opportunity set available to investors should evolve as well,” said Jon Godsall, Partner and Co-Head of New Markets at Apollo. “Victory Capital has consistently responded to evolving investor needs with disciplined product innovation and a deep focus on the long-term success of its clients. By combining Victory Capital’s model portfolio and distribution capabilities with Apollo’s platform, we can bring private market opportunities to more investors through thoughtfully constructed investment solutions.”


As part of this collaboration, Victory Capital Management Inc. has filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) for the Victory Apollo Private Markets Fund (the “Fund”), a multi-asset interval fund managed by Victory Capital that will provide exposure to a select combination of Apollo’s private markets investment strategies. The launch of the Fund is subject to registration with the SEC and fund board approval.


**About Victory Capital**


Victory Capital (NASDAQ: VCTR) is a diversified global asset management firm with $360.5 billion in total client assets, as of October 31, 2026. We serve institutional, intermediary, and individual clients through our Investment Franchises and Solutions Platform, which manage specialized investment strategies across traditional and alternative asset classes. Our differentiated approach combines the power of investment autonomy with the support of a robust, fully integrated operational and distribution platform. Clients have access to focused, top-tier investment talent equipped with comprehensive resources designed to deliver competitive long-term performance.


Victory Capital is headquartered in San Antonio, Texas. To learn more, visit[www.vcm.com](http://www.vcm.com/) or follow us on[Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/victorycapitalmanagement) ,[Twitter (X),](https://x.com/VCMtweets) and[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/victory-capital-management/?viewAsMember=true) .


**About Apollo**


Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of September 30, 2026, Apollo had approximately $1.07 trillion of assets under management.
